buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT Note: Bidders shall carefully review all tender documents and strictly comply with these conditions while submitting their bids. Quoted rates shall be firm and final; no revision shall be permitted. Clari fications, if any, may be obtained from BPCL, Pune LPG Plant, Dist. Pune. 1. Bidders or their authorized representatives are advised to visit the site before quoting to understan d the scope of work, and to be present at the time of tender opening on the due date. 2. The contract shall be valid for two years from the date of commencement and may be extended by one more year at the same rates, terms and conditions by mutual consent of BPCL and the Vendor. The Vendor shall have no right to claim an extension. 3. Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) are exempted from EMD as per the GeM GTC and the Public Proc urement Policy for MSEs Order, 2012, subject to the following: a) Valid Udyam Registration Certificate in the bidder's name, showing Micro/Small category, with NIC code covering the tendered service. b) The bidder shall be the service provider; traders are not eligible.

c) MSE status shall be validated in the bidder's GeM seller profile. d) CA certificate for MSE, dated after tender floating and specific to this tender, shall be submitted with the bid. Medium enterprises, and bidders not submitting the above documents, shall not be eligible for EMD exem ption. 5. EMD, wherever applicable, shall be submitted online through the GeM portal as per the GeM GTC. Bi dders claiming exemption shall upload the supporting documents with the bid. Bids without valid EMD or exemption documents shall be rejected. 6. Bids shall strictly conform to the tender terms and conditions. Non-conforming bids shall be rejecte d, and counter-conditions shall not be accepted. 7. EMD in any form other than that specified in the GeM bid document, including cheques or requests f or adjustment against pending dues/bills, shall not be accepted. Such bids shall be treated as received wit hout EMD and rejected. 8. EMD of unsuccessful bidders shall be refunded after finalization of the tender. EMD of the successfu l bidder(s) shall be refunded only after submission of the Security Deposit, signing of the agreement and completion of other formalities. No interest shall be paid on the EMD. 9. Quoted rates shall remain firm for the entire contract period. No escalation of any kind shall be allo wed, and no reimbursement shall be made for any new taxes, duties or levies. 10. Bidders shall quote for all items in the tender schedule. Rates shall be stated in both figures and wo rds; in case of any discrepancy, the rate in words shall prevail. 11. For security reasons, the Vendor shall carry out antecedent/police verification of its personnel and s ubmit a written confirmation and undertaking to BPCL to this effect. 12. All instructions issued by BPCL shall be complied with promptly and to the satisfaction of the concer ned officer. 13. The Vendor shall be fully responsible for, and shall guarantee, the quality of services rendered. 14. Any damage to BPCL property, equipment or facilities caused by the Vendor or its personnel, includi ng through mistake, improper handling or acting without consulting the Officer-in-Charge, shall be made good by the Vendor or recovered from its bills at a rate equivalent to the damage caused. 15. Water and electricity required for the job shall be provided by BPCL. 16. The Vendor and its personnel shall abide by all security and safety rules/regulations in force at BPC L premises. 17. Payment shall be made through NEFT within 30 days of submission of the complete monthly bill. Th e bill shall be supported by PF challans, PF slips, ESI/insurance challans, wage slips and other documents as directed by the BPCL officer. Bills shall be submitted to the TC, Pune LPG Plant within 10 days. 18. The Vendor shall comply fully with all applicable labour laws and statutory requirements, shall be so lely responsible for any breach, and shall keep BPCL indemnified against all resulting claims, damages a nd legal actions. The Vendor shall hold a valid PF registration and labour licence covering the number of personnel deployed. 19. Quoted rates shall be inclusive of all taxes, duties, manpower, tools & tackles and materials require d for the job. The work shall be carried out as per the instructions of the concerned officer. 20. The Officer-in-Charge shall inspect the work, and the Vendor shall obtain certification of satisfactory completion from the concerned sections. 21. Wages of all deployed personnel shall be paid through NEFT within the statutory timeline. Proof of p ayment of wages, PF and ESI/insurance, along with a copy of the wage register clearly showing the amou nts paid, shall be submitted with the bill. The payment proofs shall match the wage register. 22. If wages are not paid on time, BPCL reserves the right to pay the deployed personnel directly and re cover the amount from the Vendor's bills/dues. 23. Penalties shall be levied as per the Penalty Clause. 24. The contract period shall be valid for 24 months from the date of PO/LOI.

Penalty Clauses: Sr. No Nature of Default Penalty / Deduction . Short deployment / absence of manpower without su 1 ₹1,500 per person per day itable replacement Delay in payment of wages beyond the statutory tim 2 ₹1,000 per day of delay eline. Non-submission / delayed submission of PF, ESI/insur 3 ance, wage payment proof or other mandatory mont ₹500 per document per month. hly statutory documents Unsatisfactory performance or failure to carry out as 4 ₹1,000 per instance signed duties after written notice SCOPE OF WORK Subject: Providing Commercial Sales Associates, CRC Staff and Office Assistant at Pune LPG Territ ory. Provision of staff as per the table below: Sr. No Number of P Position Sales Area . ersons Pune, Ahmednagar/ Jalgaon/ 1 Commercial Sales Associates (CSA) 2 Nasik Maharashtra Customer Relationship Co-ordinator (CRC) 2 1 Staff (Except Goa, Uran, Mumbai) 3 Office Assistant Territory Office, Pune 1 Contract Period: 2 years (From 26.12.2026 to 25.12.2028) 1) ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES OF COMMERCIAL SALES ASSOCIATES The primary responsibility of the Commercial Sales Associates shall be to promote and develop Commercia l and Bulk LPG sales, expand the customer base, and maintain strong customer relationships. The scope of work shall include: a) Assess the overall market potential by visiting existing customers, customers of other OMCs, an d non-LPG users, and maintain appropriate records of the same.

b) Identify prospective customers for conversion from other fuels to LPG and educate them on the b enefits, applications, and relevant technical aspects of LPG. c) Visit existing customers regularly and inspect commercial LPG installations from a safety perspe ctive. d) Provide necessary training and guidance to staff and commercial delivery personnel. e) Carry out marketing and promotional activities, including display of banners and communication of applicable prices, discounts, promotional schemes, and other relevant information. f) Walk-in customer query resolution/ handling. g) Carry out any other work assigned by BPCL within the stipulated time. 2) ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES OF CRC STAFF AT LPG-WR, PUNE a) Attend to complaints and queries registered by LPG customers through the Customer Service Cell and captured in the Salesforce application and ensure their timely resolution and closure. b) Coordinate and follow up with the concerned distributors for resolution and closure of customer co mplaints/queries in the Salesforce application for six territories in Maharashtra, excluding Goa, Uran, an d Mumbai. 1) ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES OF OFFICE ASSISTANT AT TERRITORY OFFICE, PUNE a) Provide assistance in activities related to floating, scrutiny, compilation, and processing of transp ortation tenders for various LPG Bottling Plants in the Western Region. b) Monitor VTS reports generated for bulk lorries operating in the Western Region. c) Coordinate and communicate with transporters regarding issues related to VTS reports and their r esolution. d) Assist in verification, settlement, and processing of transportation bills and related documentation. e) Carry out any other work assigned by BPCL within the stipulated time. 4) TRAINING a) The required training module and job-related training shall be provided/arranged by BPCL through the concerned BDM or designated officials. 5) PERFORMANCE MEASURE FOR COMMERCIAL CYLINDERS Performance shall be assessed based on the following parameters: a. Coverage and maintenance of customer/market potential data, number of new customers enr olled, and sales growth. b. Additional sales volume generated from newly enrolled customers. c. Number of safety inspections carried out at commercial customer premises. d. Number of marketing/promotional activities conducted. 6) PERFORMANCE MEASURE FOR 5KG FTL Performance shall be assessed based on the following parameters: a. Increase in the number of retailers. b. Sales volume per retailer. c. Number of new NCs / operating shops. d. Number of retailer inspections carried out. 7) SKILL & COMPENSATION a) Education:

The candidate shall possess a minimum qualification of Graduate/Diploma/Engineering degree from a rec ognized university/institution. The candidate should be computer proficient, with working knowledge of MS Outlook and MS Office, particularly MS Excel, and should possess sound technical knowledge relevant to the assigned work. b) Age & Physical fitness: The candidate should be below 38 years of age and physically capable of carrying out the duties associat ed with the assigned role. c) Language: The candidate should possess good communication skills and proficiency in English, Hindi, and local vern acular language. Preference may be given to domicile candidates possessing a two-wheeler. The candidate should be energe tic and willing to work extended hours and travel/work in remote areas, wherever required. 8) WAGES & STATUTORY COMPLIANCE a) The manpower deployed under the contract shall be considered under the Highly Skilled category. b) Bonus @ 8.33% of minimum wages shall be paid by the Vendor to all deployed person nel. Bidders shall therefore quote their rates inclusive of the bonus amount, as no separat e payment shall be made by BPCL on this account. c) The Vendor shall pay wages not less than the applicable statutory minimum wages and shall comply with all applicable Central and State Labour Codes, rules, regulations and other statutory requirement s, as amended from time to time. d) The Vendor shall be responsible for all applicable statutory contributions/benefits, including PF, ESI/ insurance, bonus, gratuity, leave benefits, etc. e) The quoted rates shall be inclusive of wages, statutory contributions, administrative/service charges and all other expenses forming part of the employee's CTC, except incentive specifically provided se parately under the contract. f) Any revision in statutory minimum wages, VDA or other wage components during the co ntract period shall be borne by the Vendor. The Vendor shall pay the revised wages to the deployed personnel, and no change shall be made to the PO value on this account. Bidder s shall therefore quote their rates after considering expected wage revisions over the enti re contract period. g) A contractor's margin of 7.5% of minimum wages has been considered in the In-hous e estimate. As no minimum margin is stipulated, bidders shall decide their margin judiciou sly while quoting. A low quoted margin shall not justify short payment of wages or statuto ry dues, or any compromise in service, failing which action shall be taken as per the contr act. h) The Vendor shall indemnify BPCL against any claim, penalty, loss or liability arising from non-compli ance with applicable statutory provisions. 9) PERFORMANCE INCENTIVE In addition to the wages specified above, a performance incentive of up to ₹10,000 per month may be rei mbursed, subject to performance and approval of the Commercial/Territory Manager, Pune LPG. 10) PAYMENT OF WAGES & MONTHLY DOCUMENTATION The Vendor shall ensure timely payment of monthly wages through bank transfer or any other legally perm issible traceable mode within the prescribed timeline. The following documents, as applicable, shall be submitted along with the monthly bill: · Attendance Register/Muster Roll · Wage Register/Wage Statement · Salary/Wage slips

· Proof of wage payment · PF challan/ECR and applicable statutory contribution records · Any other statutory documents required by BPCL Delay in payment of wages may attract penalty, withholding or recovery from the Vendor's bills, as specifie d in the tender conditions. 11) DOCUMENTS BEFORE DEPLOYMENT The successful Vendor shall submit the following documents within 15 days from the date of LOI or bef ore deployment, whichever is earlier: · Details of personnel proposed for deployment · Educational qualification and experience certificates · Wage/salary structure · PF/UAN and ESI/insurance details, as applicable · Employment/appointment documents · Identity and address proof · Photograph and contact details · Any other documents required by BPCL Non-submission of mandatory documents within the stipulated period may attract appropriate action as pe r the contract. 12) DEPLOYMENT, LEAVE & REPLACEMENT The Vendor shall ensure uninterrupted deployment of the stipulated 4 Nos. Highly Skilled Office Staff hroughout the contract period. Commercial Sales Associates, CRC Staff and the Office Assistant shall be entitled to two days of leave fo r each completed month of service. Leave beyond the permissible entitlement shall attract proportion ate deduction. The Vendor shall arrange a suitably qualified replacement in case of absence, resignation, discontinuation or other manpower shortfall, wherever required, to ensure continuity of work. Short deployment shall attract proportionate deduction and/or penalty as specified in the Penalty Clause 13) SUPERVISION & CONDUCT The Vendor shall be responsible for the supervision, discipline and administrative control of the deployed p ersonnel. In case of unsatisfactory conduct, suitability or non-compliance, BPCL may require the Vendor to take corrective action or provide a suitably qualified replacement. 14) CONFIDENTIALITY The Vendor and deployed personnel shall maintain strict confidentiality of all BPCL information, documents, customer data, systems and correspondence accessed during the contract. No BPCL information shall be copied, disclosed or shared with any third party without prior authorization. T he confidentiality obligation shall continue after completion/termination of the contract, wherever applicabl e. 15) SUB-CONTRACTING The Vendor shall not sub-contract, transfer or assign the contract, wholly or partly, without prior written ap proval of BPCL.
